submitted.rationale: Only 3 merit measurements were allowed. The near-BiVO4 composition (idx 293, Bi:V≈1:1) gave 1.24 µA. Moving into the densely sampled V-rich, Cu-containing region raised the photocurrent to 4.12 µA (idx 1). Continuing in that direction with less Bi and slightly more Cu and V (idx 59, Bi0.12 Cu0.27 V0.61) gave the highest value, 6.01 µA.
